title: Header nav — semantic icons
brief: Replace the four text tabs in the fixed header (Timer, Planning, Distractions, Metrics) with semantic lucide icons; explore tooltip disclosure and active-state strategies. Candidates: timer, calendar-days, ghost, bar-chart-3.

artboards.title: Icons + tooltip
artboards.tradeoff: Maximal minimalism; discoverability rests entirely on tooltips, and touch devices have no hover

artboards.title: Icons beside labels
artboards.tradeoff: Fully discoverable with zero learning cost; keeps nearly all of today's width, gains polish not space

artboards.title: Segmented pill
artboards.tradeoff: Strongest active state and touch-friendly targets; most visual weight, reads as a control rather than airy chrome
